Adhyayan Suman's Film Postponed to Avoid Box Office Clash

Adhyayan Suman's film 'Main Na Raha Mera' has been postponed from its October release to December. This decision was made to avoid a box office clash with Ayushmann Khurrana's film, which was also scheduled for release in October.
